prs.author: raashish1601

Both PRs replace it with the same `pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')` regex-based strip. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix the same root cause: buildWellKnownPath() only stripped a single trailing slash from pathname (`if (pathname.endsWith('/')) pathname = pathname.slice(0, -1)`), which fails on multi-slash pathnames and produces malformed `.well-known` discovery URLs. prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs apply the identical `/\/+$/` regex fix to buildWellKnownPath, but #2215 factors it into a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper and also updates `shouldAttemptFallback`'s root check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''`. That follow-on fix is necessary once the normalization is applied: after stripping, a root path normalizes to `''` rather than `'/'`, so #2214's version alone would leave `shouldAttemptFallback`'s root short-circuit permanently dead, causing an unnecessary extra fallback request for every root-path OAuth server. #2214 only touches buildWellKnownPath/buildDiscoveryUrls and does not update `shouldAttemptFallback`, so it does not cover this case.

members.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs apply the identical `/\/+$/` regex fix to buildWellKnownPath, but #2215 factors it into a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper and also updates `shouldAttemptFallback`'s root check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''`. That follow-on fix is necessary once the normalization is applied: after stripping, a root path normalizes to `''` rather than `'/'`, so #2214's version alone would leave `shouldAttemptFallback`'s root short-circuit permanently dead, causing an unnecessary extra fallback request for every root-path OAuth server. #2214 only touches buildWellKnownPath/buildDiscoveryUrls and does not update `shouldAttemptFallback`, so it does not cover this case.
